Name: Too Many Elliott Portraits - Fixed Originals - Forward-Facing - Topless - Seasonal - Flower Festival
Author: LumenDeLumine
Description:
Soooo.... I made a mod that fixed some of Elliott's portraits. And then I added 16 topless versions. Oops. I figured I might as well upload it here, so I did. And it was good.

But then I was still dissatisfied. Inspired by some other folks who made a forward-facing Elliott (they are pretty neat and warrant being checked out), I knew what I had to do next. I made clothed, forward-facing versions of the original Elliott. And then I was still dissatisfied, so I made topless versions of those too. And then one of the lovely folks who downloaded this mod was left wanting for Forward Facing Seasonal Outfits for Elliott, and Flower Festival portraits, too, and I thought, "MUST!!! ENSURE!!! HAPPINESS!!! OF!!!! PERSON!!!!" So I did that, too. I seem to be out of control. I don't know what happened.

I got permission from Tanpoponoko to use the Elliott portraits in the Seasonal Outfits mod in order to make forward-facing versions of the seasonal outfits. Please go check out Tanpoponoko's mod; I have replacement images for the corresponding Elliotts, but to be honest, I am not sure how to make it all work. I'm just an images person; I don't really understand how to do anything else, hahahaha!

And... now there are Flower Festival portraits now, too? Both standard and forward-facing. I don't really know why. Someone help me. Hahahaha!

So... now there are a lot more portraits. I have no idea what I am going to do with them because I don't know how to do anything. I figured I might as well stick what I did here, just in case anyone else knows what to do with them.

I wanted to try to replace the generic textbox that asks if you want a kid with a portraitbox instead, which was what the first image I made was for. But I don't know how. If anyone knows how, please tell me. I have gotten to the point where I have figured out that ALL questions asked by characters in the game use a generic textbox. So now I might have to write an entirely new function on my own to make it do what I want it to. I am sad because there are no useful comments in the actual game code when I cracked it open and looked at it.

Anywho. I have an XNB file with all the sprites that I fixed/uploaded. And also a zip with all the Seasonal Outfit portraits I modified. And a zip with the Flower Festival portraits. I don't know if they're right, so please crack 'em open and check 'em; if they're not right, please tell me. Or you can fix them yourself, I guess. If you want to.

Use it for whatever. Just credit me for my work, okay? And also check out Seasonal Outfits! Because it is awesome.
